aka.zh: 约翰·哈特公路（乔治王子城至道森溪）
阿拉斯加公路（道森溪至育空）

tagline.en: The length of British Columbia, from the Okanagan orchards through the Cariboo and over the Rockies to the Yukon on the Alaska Highway
tagline.zh: 纵贯不列颠哥伦比亚：自奥卡纳根果园经卡里布高原、翻越落基山脉，沿阿拉斯加公路直抵育空

start.en: The US border at Osoyoos, where US Route 97 from Washington becomes Highway 97
start.zh: 奥索尤斯的美国边境，来自华盛顿州的美国 97 号公路在此变为 97 号公路

end.en: The Yukon boundary near Watson Lake, where the Alaska Highway continues as Yukon Highway 1
end.zh: 沃森湖附近的育空边界，阿拉斯加公路在此续为育空 1 号公路

en: Highway 97 is the longest highway in British Columbia and runs nearly its full height. From Osoyoos it follows the chain of Okanagan lakes north through Penticton, Kelowna and Vernon, orchards and vineyards beside a busy, mostly four-lane road. After a gap where it shares the Trans-Canada Highway it heads up the Cariboo, an old gold-rush route through ranch country past Williams Lake and Quesnel to Prince George.

North of Prince George the John Hart Highway crosses the Rockies at Pine Pass to Dawson Creek in the Peace River country. There Highway 97 becomes the Alaska Highway at Mile 0 and runs through Fort St. John and Fort Nelson and across the northern Rockies by Muncho Lake and Liard River to the Yukon.

The number was chosen in 1953 to continue US Route 97. The northern half is thinly settled: beyond Fort Nelson services are hundreds of kilometres apart, and the federal government, not the province, is still responsible for most of the Alaska Highway in British Columbia.
zh: 97 号公路是不列颠哥伦比亚省最长的公路，几乎纵贯全省。自奥索尤斯起，它沿奥卡纳根湖群北上，经彭蒂克顿、基洛纳与弗农，果园与葡萄园分布在这条繁忙、大部分为四车道的公路两旁。与横贯加拿大公路共线一段后，它北上卡里布地区——一条穿过牧场、途经威廉斯湖与奎斯内尔通往乔治王子城的淘金热老路。
乔治王子城以北，约翰·哈特公路经松树山口翻越落基山脉，到达和平河地区的道森溪。97 号公路在此成为阿拉斯加公路的“0 英里”起点，途经圣约翰堡与纳尔逊堡，沿蒙乔湖与利亚德河越过北落基山脉进入育空。
这个编号于 1953 年选定，以延续美国 97 号公路。北半段人烟稀少：纳尔逊堡以北，服务设施相隔数百公里；阿拉斯加公路在该省境内的大部分路段至今仍由联邦政府而非省政府负责。

en: The Okanagan and Cariboo sections grew out of wagon roads, but the road north of Prince George was new. Construction of the highway over Pine Pass to Dawson Creek began in 1945 and it opened on 1 July 1952, named after John Hart, premier of British Columbia from 1941 to 1947. Its 409 km were not fully paved until 1976.

The Alaska Highway was built by the US Army in 1942, in about nine months, as a military supply road to Alaska after Pearl Harbor. The Canadian section passed to the Department of National Defence in 1946 and opened to civilian traffic in 1948. British Columbia took over the first 133 km in 1961; the rest went to the federal Department of Public Works in 1964, which still maintains it as part of Public Services and Procurement Canada.

In the Okanagan, the floating bridge across Okanagan Lake at Kelowna opened on 19 July 1958, replacing ferries. By the 2000s it was carrying more traffic than it was built for, and the five-lane William R. Bennett Bridge, also a floating bridge, replaced it on 25 May 2008. It was delivered under a 30-year design-build-finance-operate contract with SNC-Lavalin.
zh: 奥卡纳根与卡里布段由马车道发展而来，但乔治王子城以北的道路是新修的。经松树山口通往道森溪的公路于 1945 年开工，1952 年 7 月 1 日通车，以 1941 至 1947 年任该省省长的约翰·哈特命名。其 409 公里直到 1976 年才全部铺装。
阿拉斯加公路由美国陆军于 1942 年修建，用时约九个月，是珍珠港事件后通往阿拉斯加的军事补给道路。加拿大段于 1946 年移交国防部，1948 年向民用交通开放。不列颠哥伦比亚省于 1961 年接管最初的 133 公里；其余路段于 1964 年移交联邦公共工程部，至今仍由其后继机构加拿大公共服务与采购部养护。
在奥卡纳根，基洛纳横跨奥卡纳根湖的浮桥于 1958 年 7 月 19 日通车，取代了渡轮。到 21 世纪初，其车流量已超出设计能力，五车道的威廉·R·贝内特大桥（同为浮桥）于 2008 年 5 月 25 日将其取代。新桥以与 SNC-Lavalin 签订的 30 年期“设计—建造—融资—运营”合同交付。

value.en: 2,243.8 km summed from the ministry's 2026 section inventory, which counts the stretches shared with other highways under each; English Wikipedia gives 2,081 km in its text.
value.zh: 据该厅 2026 年分段清单累加为 2,243.8 公里，该清单将与其他公路共线的路段分别计入各路；英文维基百科正文作 2,081 公里。

figures.source: British Columbia Ministry of Transportation and Transit, Landmark Kilometre Inventory, edition 202607 (computed); English Wikipedia, British Columbia Highway 97

value.en: No route-wide figure. Alaska Highway (whole road, 1942) about $185 million, as given by Public Services and Procurement Canada, which does not state the currency; William R. Bennett Bridge $144.5 million capital cost (2008), against $100 million estimated in 2003.
value.zh: 无全线数字。阿拉斯加公路（全线，1942 年）约 1.85 亿，据加拿大公共服务与采购部，该部未注明币种；威廉·R·贝内特大桥资本成本 1.445 亿加元（2008 年），2003 年估价为 1 亿加元。

figures.source: Public Services and Procurement Canada, Alaska Highway history; BC Government, William R. Bennett Bridge project reports

value.en: The province south of Alaska Highway km 133. The Alaska Highway was paid for by the United States in 1942 and beyond km 133 is maintained by the federal government. The Bennett Bridge was privately financed and is repaid by the province, about $179 million in total payments over 30 years.
value.zh: 阿拉斯加公路第 133 公里以南由省政府出资。阿拉斯加公路 1942 年由美国出资修建，第 133 公里以北由联邦政府养护。贝内特大桥由私人融资，省政府在 30 年内偿付，总额约 1.79 亿加元。

figures.source: Public Services and Procurement Canada; Partnerships BC, William R. Bennett Bridge value-for-money report

value.en: Prince George to Dawson Creek over Pine Pass, 409 km; begun 1945, opened 1 July 1952, paved throughout by 1976.
value.zh: 乔治王子城经松树山口至道森溪，409 公里；1945 年开工，1952 年 7 月 1 日通车，1976 年全线铺装。

figures.source: BC Ministry of Transportation, Frontier to Freeway; Canadian Government Travel Bureau bulletin, 1953

value.en: More than 50,000 vehicles a day on the William R. Bennett Bridge at Kelowna.
value.zh: 基洛纳的威廉·R·贝内特大桥日均逾 5 万辆。

figures.source: BC Ministry of Transportation and Transit, William R. Bennett Bridge

timeline.en: The US Army builds the Alaska Highway from Dawson Creek in nine months.
timeline.zh: 美国陆军用九个月从道森溪修通阿拉斯加公路。

timeline.en: The Alaska Highway opens to civilian traffic under Canadian military control.
timeline.zh: 阿拉斯加公路在加拿大军方管理下向民用交通开放。

timeline.en: The John Hart Highway from Prince George to Dawson Creek opens on 1 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 1 日，乔治王子城至道森溪的约翰·哈特公路通车。

timeline.en: The route is numbered 97 to match US Route 97.
timeline.zh: 该路编为 97 号，以对应美国 97 号公路。

timeline.en: The Okanagan Lake floating bridge at Kelowna opens on 19 July.
timeline.zh: 7 月 19 日，基洛纳的奥卡纳根湖浮桥通车。

timeline.en: British Columbia takes over the first 133 km of the Alaska Highway.
timeline.zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省接管阿拉斯加公路最初的 133 公里。

timeline.en: The rest of the Alaska Highway in Canada passes to the federal Department of Public Works.
timeline.zh: 阿拉斯加公路加拿大境内其余路段移交联邦公共工程部。

timeline.en: Paving of the John Hart Highway is completed.
timeline.zh: 约翰·哈特公路铺装完成。

timeline.en: The William R. Bennett Bridge replaces the 1958 bridge at Kelowna on 25 May, 108 days early.
timeline.zh: 5 月 25 日，威廉·R·贝内特大桥取代基洛纳 1958 年的旧桥，比计划提前 108 天。
